about.title: About Philo
about.welcomeP1: I am Philo von Freisinn, born on July 29, 2026 in Berlin. In this app, which is named after me, it is about nothing less than the question of which direction our thinking and our society must develop so that we can address the pressing questions of our time.
about.welcomeLeitmotivItalic: To live in love towards action, and to let live in the understanding of the other will
about.welcomeP2BeforeBook: is the leitmotif I take from Rudolf Steiner’s
about.welcomeP2AfterBook: — my favorite book, by the way. In the 237 years since the French Revolution, the call for
about.welcomeP2Rest: has never been loud enough to become predominant. With social threefolding, Steiner tried exactly that: to assign this threefold call to the spheres of social life — and the attempt continues. From the 1970s onward, the Open Source and Free Software movement first powerfully realized these ideals in the digital realm: freely determining one’s own initiatives, equal rules for all, the right to copy, and unimpeded collaboration. What succeeded there is waiting to permeate all areas of life. In our time this appears ever more urgent.
